def dfs(graph, start, goal, path, visited, recur, recur_k, recurk, recurk_k):    
    if start == goal:        
        return path    
    if start in visited or start in recur or start in recur_k or start in recurk or start in recurk_k:        
        return None        
    visited.add(start)    
    recur.add(start)    
    path.append(start)

def dfs_v2(graph, start, goal, path, visited, recur, recur_k, recurk, recurk_k):    
    if start == goal:          
        return path    
    out = False    
    for neighbor in graph[start]:        
        if neighbor not in visited:            
            visited.add(neighbor)            
            recur.add(neighbor)            
            path.append(neighbor)            
            result = dfs_v2(graph, neighbor, goal, path[:], visited, recur, recur_k, recurk, recurk_k)            
            if result:                
                return result        
        recur.remove(neighbor)        
        recur_k.add(neighbor)        
        if len(recur_k) > 0:            
            path.pop()            
            return None        

def find_path(graph, start, goal):    
    if start == goal:        
        return [start]    
    path = [start]    
    visited = set([start])    
    recur = set([start])    
    recur_k = set()    
    recurk = set()    
    recurk_k = set()    
    result = dfs(graph, start, goal, path, visited, recur, recur_k, recurk, recurk_k)    
    if result:        
        return result    
    result = dfs_v2(graph, start, goal, path, visited, recur, recur_k, recurk, recurk_k)    
    if result:        
        return result    
    return None
